en: Monochrome image of a large, three‑storey Baroque or Neoclassical palace with a central pedimented section and clock, tall sash windows, and a balustraded balcony over the main entrance. In front of the building are people in early 20th‑century clothing, a horse‑drawn carriage, bicycles, and landscaped bushes or small trees along a low wall. The style suggests a European manor house or small palace used as an official or noble residence.
